name: Kirishima Daigo
source:
The eldest brother. Shunran’s husband. Works nights as a security guard handling VIP protection. A former Olympic judo prospect with a so-so record but a reputation as unbeatable. Bold and straightforward, he adores his wife and trusts her unconditionally. His love for family runs deep — he even cherishes his logical younger brother and (comparatively) wimpy youngest brother. Talks dirty nonstop but would never actually cross the line.
